title: Heavenly Andalusian Tart with Garlic Potatoes
description: A delicious and savory tart filled with the flavors of Andalusia, paired with crispy garlic potatoes.
instructions: Roll out the tart crust and place on a baking sheet.
Toss the sliced potatoes with olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Spread them on the baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until crispy.
Meanwhile, layer the Andalusian olives and shredded Heavenly cheese on the tart crust.
Once the potatoes are done, remove them from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Arrange the roasted potatoes on top of the tart filling.
Bake the tart in the preheated oven for an additional 10-15 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
